rca of the issue: Original bug: TrialSignupModal.js registers a window-level keydown listener that closes the entire signup on Escape. The CH dropdown had no Escape handler of its own, so the keystroke bubbled up and dismissed the whole flow. Fix in CompaniesHouseSearch adds an input-level onKeyDown that, when dropdown is open, calls preventDefault + stopPropagation + nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation and only calls setOpen(false). It also adds a wrapRef + mousedown listener to support click-outside dismissal. Verified: Escape no longer navigates/closes the page; click-outside hides dropdown; re-typing re-opens it; no new console errors.
